links.outcome: LLM output self-consistency across three repeated runs
links.effect: High self-consistency (>90%) across the three runs per patient, aggregated by majority voting.
links.quote: The LLM showed high self-consistency (>90% across runs).

unlisted_practices: Structured prompt with kinematic features extracted by an open-source toolkit to generate gait deviation findings
Majority voting across repeated LLM runs to determine final output

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and accuracy/agreement of an LLM (prompted with kinematic features) in detecting gait deviations and recommending surgical procedures compared to expert ratings in a retrospective offline study.
